events.body:
## Context

Sorting is a click listener on plain `<th data-col>` elements (generated in `scripts/generate_page.py`), which aren't focusable and have no `aria-sort`. `applyFilter` counts visible rows but never uses the count, so a search with no matches leaves an empty table.

## What to do

1. Wrap header labels in `<button type="button">` and set `aria-sort` on the active column.
2. Add a `#no-results` message with `aria-live="polite"` shown when nothing matches.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tab reaches headers; Enter/Space sorts
- [ ] `aria-sort` reflects state
- [ ] Searching "zzzz" shows the message

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-ideas && python3 scripts/generate_page.py && python3 -m http.server -d dist 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
